request.style: English, female mezzo-soprano solo, choir, harp, flute, strings, soft percussion, solemn and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
After the mountain and the ram
Abraham heard the news again
His brother Nahor had more sons
Born in the distant land

[Chorus]
His concubine Reumah bore
Four sons to the old clan
Tebah was the firstborn son
Written in the genealogy

[Verse]
Gaham Tahash and Maacah
Followed in the list
Names from the Mesopotamian shore
Where the patriarchs dwell

[Chorus]
His concubine Reumah bore
Four sons to the old clan
Tebah was the firstborn son
Written in the genealogy

[Chorus]
His concubine Reumah bore
Four sons to the old clan
Tebah was the firstborn son
Written in the genealogy

[Outro]
A name in the family tree
Roots from Ur of the Chaldees
